p7_normalisation.reading: [DERIVED] For an n = 1 polytrope (rho ~ theta, P ~ theta^2, theta = sin xi/xi) 3 int P dV / int rho c^2 dV = w_c * (pi/2)/pi = w_c/2, so P7's flat ratio is 1 - w_c/2 (normalised to the rest mass). Normalised to the Tolman mass (eps + 3P) the deficit is 6 int P / int eps = w_c at first order. The two differ by normalisation, not by a correction to P7, so the M8 small-w_c slope test is bug-only.
